metadata.title: Master Plan for Delhi 2047 -- ZONE BOUNDARY
metadata.pagination: ordered by objectid ASC, page size 150, objectid-deduplicated
metadata.plan_status: MPD-2047 approved by DDA 2026-08-12 and notified by MoHUA as an extensive modification of MPD-2021.
metadata.coverage_caveat: Planned land use as published by DDA. It is a statutory plan, not a survey of what exists on the ground, and must not be read as current land use.
metadata.geography_caveat: Organised by DDA planning zones (for example P-I, L, N), which are not the 15 Delhi Police districts this dashboard is built on. Any attribution to a police district or MCD ward has to come from an explicit areal intersection, never a name match.
metadata.attribution: Delhi Development Authority, Master Plan for Delhi 2047 GIS portal (gis.dda.org.in)
metadata.legend_note: This layer publishes no uniqueValue renderer, so no codebook was captured.
